operator: Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MPMRCL) — Indore Metro Yellow Line
notes: Indore Metro Yellow Line — only the 6 km "Super Priority Corridor" (5 stations, Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Terminal – Veerangana Jhalkari Bai) is operational since 31 May 2025 (commercial 1 Jun 2025). The remaining 24 of 29 planned stations (through Airport, 33.53 km) are under construction/approved and are NOT included, as they carry no service. Station order and operational status from Wikipedia + themetrorailguy + myindoremetro + yometro. All 5 coordinates are OSM/Wikidata WGS-84 (Q134725694/95/96/97/98), monotonic SW→NE along the corridor. Service model: launch schedule = 08:00–20:00 daily, 30-min headway, ~25 trips/direction (50/day). One representative trip per direction is provided at first departure (08:00); segment run times (~13.5 min end-to-end over 5.9 km) are estimated from corridor length since per-station times are not published. Some later 2025 listings cite revised 06:00–22:00 / 10-min frequency, but the launch 08:00–20:00 / 30-min figures are used as best-attested. Fares not announced by MPMRCL at time of scrape. Confidence 0.62: stops/order/coordinates are solid; exact timetable (headway, dwell, per-hop times) is approximated.
